claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: On physicality, San Jose is one of the league’s best and Nashville is one of the league’s worst. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Sharks and the Predators sit at opposite ends for physicality.
claims.call: The Sharks hit more than the Predators in the close stretches of the game.

claims.head: The Sharks’ defense joins the attack; the Predators’ stays home
